interpretation: The annual fiscal-year register is the stronger historical source than AAP-sorted derivatives when counts or schemas differ.
The historical register mixes discipline and incident rows; Incident must not be treated as discipline merely because it appears in the disciplinary workbook.
Legacy action labels require normalization for analysis but source labels must be preserved.
AAP derivatives appear to have been manually transformed and sometimes expanded; they require reconciliation before reuse.
